concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a defence brew called stoneguard brew. A squat round stoneware jug with a wide belly and short neck, glazed in grey-blue with a soft drippy glaze line and visible speckles, a thick twisted rope loop handle on one side, and a rough rounded grey stone stopper in the neck. Sturdy and heavy-looking, flat base. About 0.40 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: squat round grey-blue speckled stoneware jug, twisted rope loop handle through two lugs, rough grey stone stopper; 3 consistent views
